news.title: Augustana School of Music Celebrates 89 Years of Christmas Vespers With Three Services
news.summary_en: TheAugustana Office of Faith & Spiritual LifeandAugustana School of Music (SoM)is inviting the public to join the university community for its 89th annual Christmas Vespers: “A Journey to Light," with services taking place on Dec. 4 and 5.

news.title: Augustana Faculty, Visiting Artists to Showcase Work at Eide/Dalrymple Gallery
news.summary_en: TheEide/Dalrymple Galleryat Augustana is showcasing recent works by university art instructors and faculty, as well as visiting artists for “The Augustana Faculty Biennial." The exhibit will be on view from Thursday, Nov. 5, through Saturday, Dec. 5. A gallery reception will take place from 7-9 p.m. on Friday, Nov. 6, with a gallery talk at 7:30 p.m.
